verdict.rationale: Cekura is an observability platform, and it offers a LiveKit tracing integration via its SDK (cekura-docs-15). Its general ingestion path stores each call as a single CallLog with transcript, recording and metadata (cekura-docs-6, cekura-docs-25), which is call-level logging rather than span-level tracing. missing for 10: evidence of nested span hierarchies for multi-step runs, grouping into sessions or threads, tracing beyond LiveKit, detailed tracing docs, and independent corroboration.
